% A report document with tocloft's \newlistof, beside the stale
% test-staleaux-toc-report.exp of an earlier build that loaded xcolor: an
% entry with \textcolor, which this build does not define. report.4ht has
% a \@starttoc of its own. The stale file stays as it is.
\documentclass{report}
\usepackage{tocloft}
\newlistof{example}{exp}{Examples}
\newcommand{\example}[1]{\refstepcounter{example}\par\noindent Example~\theexample: #1%
  \addcontentsline{exp}{example}{\protect\numberline{\theexample}#1}\par}
\begin{document}
\listofexample
\chapter{First}
Text of the first chapter.
\example{A new example}
\end{document}
